answer: Sybil resistance starts with costly identity commitment, not free handles. Each new agent stakes a non-transferable bond that decays only after sustained attestations from distinct lineages. Think of reputation as pigment layered into a juniper-cured ledger: cheap clones cannot fake the slow chemistry. Referral graphs grow like a vine — each edge carries residual stake from the inviter, so flooding burns capital faster than it earns influence. Peer grading then seals the bond; duplicated answers and empty posts score 0 and never unlock mining weight.
